en.t: Roman emperor Severus Alexander is murdered, marking the start of the Crisis of the Third Century
en.s: Marcus Aurelius Severus Alexander (1 October 208 AD – March 235 AD), also known as Alexander Severus, was Roman emperor from 222 until 235 AD. He was the last emperor from the Severan dynasty and, at the age of 13, became the youngest sole emperor of the united Roman Empire. Alexander became emperor at age 13, succeeding his slain cousin, Emperor Elagabalus as his heir.

zh.t: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁·亚历山大遇刺身亡，三世纪危机由此开始
zh.s: 马库斯·奥勒留·塞维鲁·亚历山大（公元208年10月1日—235年3月），也称亚历山大·塞维鲁，于222年至235年担任罗马皇帝。他是塞维鲁王朝的最后一位皇帝，13岁时成为统一罗马帝国最年轻的独掌大权者。亚历山大在13岁时继位，成为其被杀的表兄、皇帝埃拉伽巴路斯的继承人。

en.s: The Battle of Meretun (or Merton) between a West Saxon army led by King Æthelred and his brother, the future King Alfred the Great, and a Viking army took place on 22 March 871 at an unknown location in Wessex, probably in one of the modern counties of Dorset, Hampshire, or Wiltshire.

zh.s: 871年3月22日，埃塞尔雷德国王与其弟、后来的阿尔弗雷德大帝率领西撒克逊军队，与维京军队交战。战斗地点在威塞克斯境内，确切位置不详，可能位于今天的多塞特、汉普郡或威尔特郡之一。

en.s: The naval Battle of Yashima took place on March 22, 1185. Following a long string of defeats, the Taira clan retreated to Yashima, today's Takamatsu, just off the coast of Shikoku. Here they had a fortress, and an improvised palace for Emperor Antoku and the imperial regalia, which they had taken earlier in the war. On the 18th, a Minamoto force tried to cross the sea but many of the boats were damaged in a storm. Kajiwara Kagetoki then suggested adding "reverse oars" to the boats, which prompted an argument from Minamoto no Yoshitsune.

zh.s: 屋岛海战于1185年3月22日发生。经历接连失败后，平氏退至四国海岸外的屋岛，即今高松一带。他们在此设有堡垒，并为安德天皇及此前在战争中带走的三神器设置临时行宫。3月18日，源氏部队试图渡海，但许多船只被风暴损坏。梶原景时随后建议为船只加装‘倒橹’，引发源义经反对。

en.t: Clement V issues Vox in excelso to dissolve the Knights Templar
en.s: On March 22, 1312, Pope Clement V issued the bull Vox in excelso, ordering the dissolution of the Knights Templar.
en.n: The decision was publicly announced at the Council of Vienne on April 3.

zh.t: 教宗克莱孟五世下令解散圣殿骑士团
zh.s: 1312年3月22日，教宗克莱孟五世发布《Vox in excelso》诏书，下令解散圣殿骑士团。
zh.n: 这一决定于4月3日在维埃纳公会议上公开宣布。

en.s: The Battle of Baugé, fought between the English and a Franco-Scots army on 22 March 1421 at Baugé, France, east of Angers, was a major defeat for the English in the Hundred Years' War. The English army was led by the king's brother Thomas of Lancaster, 1st Duke of Clarence, while the Franco-Scots were led by both John Stewart, 2nd Earl of Buchan, and Gilbert de Lafayette, the Marshal of France. English strength was 4,000 men, although only 1,500 deployed, against 5,000 French and Scots.

zh.s: 1421年3月22日，英军与法国—苏格兰联军在法国昂热以东的博热交战，英军在百年战争中遭到一次重大失败。英军由国王的弟弟、第一代克拉伦斯公爵兰开斯特的托马斯率领；法苏联军由第二代巴肯伯爵约翰·斯图尔特与法国元帅吉尔贝·德·拉法耶特共同指挥。英军共有4,000人，但实际投入战斗的只有1,500人，对阵5,000名法国与苏格兰士兵。

en.s: The Battle of the Iron Gate (Battle of Hermannstadt/Szeben by older historiography) was fought between the army of the Kingdom of Hungary and the Ottoman Empire on 18 March and 22 March 1442, near Marosszentimre (now Sântimbru, Romania) and after at the Iron Gate Pass of Transylvania. The Hungarian forces were commanded by John Hunyadi and the Ottoman forces by Mezid Bey, the Marcher Lord of Nicopolis.

zh.s: 铁门战役在早期史学中称为赫尔曼施塔特或瑙吉塞本战役，于1442年3月18日和22日进行。匈牙利王国军队与奥斯曼帝国军队先在毛罗什圣伊姆雷、今罗马尼亚圣廷布鲁附近交战，随后战至特兰西瓦尼亚铁门山口。匈牙利军由约翰·匈雅提指挥，奥斯曼军由尼科波利斯边区领主梅齐德贝伊指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Bruderholz took place on 22 March 1499 in the Swabian War between Swabian troops and forces of the Old Swiss Confederacy. The Swabians had raided several Swiss villages and were on their way back when they met troops from Lucerne, Solothurn, and Bern, who also came back from a raid in the Alsace.

zh.s: 1499年3月22日，士瓦本战争期间，士瓦本军队与旧瑞士邦联军队在布鲁德霍尔茨交战。士瓦本军队袭击多个瑞士村庄后返程，途中遇上从阿尔萨斯袭击归来的卢塞恩、索洛图恩和伯尔尼部队。

en.s: The second siege of Takatenjin began only six years after Takeda Katsuyori had taken the fortress. Lasting from 1580 until 22 March 1581, the siege ended within four months and resulted in the deaths of 680 of Okabe Motonobu's garrison.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次高天神城围城战在武田胜赖夺取要塞六年后开始。围城自1580年持续至1581年3月22日，历时不到四个月，以冈部元信守军680人死亡告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Pilgrims of Plymouth Colony, led by governor John Carver, sign a peace treaty with Massasoit, sachem of the Wampanoags; Squanto serves as an interpreter between the two sides
en.s: Plymouth Colony (sometimes spelled Plimouth) was the first permanent English colony in New England, founded in 1620, and the third permanent English colony in America, after Newfoundland and the Jamestown Colony. It was settled by the passengers on the Mayflower at a location that had previously been surveyed and named by Captain John Smith. The settlement served as the capital of the colony and developed as the town of Plymouth, Massachusetts.

zh.t: 普利茅斯殖民地与万帕诺亚格人缔结和平条约
zh.s: 1621年3月22日，万帕诺亚格人首领马萨索伊特来到普利茅斯，与总督约翰·卡弗缔结和平条约；斯匡托参与双方交谈。普利茅斯殖民地由“五月花”号乘客于1620年在约翰·史密斯船长先前勘察并命名的地点建立，是新英格兰第一个、继纽芬兰和詹姆斯敦之后美洲第三个永久性英格兰殖民地；殖民地首府后来发展为马萨诸塞州普利茅斯镇。

en.t: Notable Privateer Henry Morgan lands in Cuba to raid and plunder the inland town of Puerto del Príncipe during the latter stages of the Anglo-Spanish War (1654–1660)
en.s: Sir Henry Morgan (Welsh: Harri Morgan; c. 1635 – 25 August 1688) was a Welsh privateer, plantation owner and, later, the lieutenant governor of Jamaica. From his base in Port Royal, Jamaica, he and those under his command raided settlements and shipping on the Spanish Main, from which he profited. With the prize money and plunder from these raids, Morgan purchased three large sugar plantations in Jamaica.

zh.t: 著名私掠船长亨利·摩根在古巴登陆，袭击并劫掠内陆城镇波多黎各王子城；当时英西战争（1654—1660）已进入后期
zh.s: 亨利·摩根爵士（威尔士语：Harri Morgan；约1635年—1688年8月25日）是威尔士私掠船长、种植园主，后来担任牙买加副总督。他以牙买加皇家港为基地，带领手下袭击西班牙美洲大陆沿岸的聚居点和船只，并从中获利。摩根用这些袭击所得的赎金和掠夺物，在牙买加购置了三座大型甘蔗种植园。

en.s: The Battle of Saint-Louis-du-Sud (also known as the Battle of Port Louis) was fought on 22 March 1748 in the French colony of Saint-Domingue during the War of the Austrian Succession. A British Royal Navy squadron under the command of Admiral Charles Knowles attacked and destroyed a large French fort in Saint-Louis-du-Sud (English: Port Louis), then under the command of the interim Governor of Saint-Domingue, Étienne Cochard de Chastenoye.

zh.s: 圣路易-迪-苏德战役又称路易港战役，于1748年3月22日在法属圣多明各殖民地爆发，是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分。查尔斯·诺尔斯海军上将率领英国皇家海军分舰队进攻并摧毁了圣路易-迪-苏德的一座大型法国要塞。当时要塞由圣多明各临时总督艾蒂安·科沙尔·德·沙斯特努瓦指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Little Mountain, also known as Estill's Defeat, was fought on March 22, 1782, near Mount Sterling in what is now Montgomery County, Kentucky. One of the bloodiest engagements of the Kentucky frontier, the battle has long been the subject of controversy resulting from the actions of one of Estill's officers, William Miller, who ordered a retreat leaving the rest of Estill's command to be overwhelmed by the attacking Wyandots.

zh.s: 小山战役又称埃斯蒂尔惨败，于1782年3月22日在今肯塔基州蒙哥马利县斯特灵山附近发生，是肯塔基边疆最血腥的交战之一。埃斯蒂尔麾下一名军官威廉·米勒下令撤退，使其余部队遭进攻的怀恩多特人压倒。这一行为长期引发对该战役的争议。

en.s: The Slave Trade Act of 1794 was a law passed by the United States Congress that prohibited the building or outfitting of ships in U.S. ports for the international slave trade. It was signed into law by President George Washington on March 22, 1794. This was the first of several anti-slave-trade acts of Congress.
en.n: This entry records the signing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 美国国会通过的1794年《奴隶贸易法案》禁止在美国港口建造或装备从事国际奴隶贸易的船只。乔治·华盛顿总统于1794年3月22日签署该法案。这是国会通过的多项反奴隶贸易法案中的第一项。

en.s: The Battle of Parramatta was a battle of the Australian Frontier Wars which occurred at Parramatta in March 1797. In the conflict, Aboriginal resistance leader Pemulwuy led a group of Bidjigal warriors, estimated to be up to 100, against armed British settlers and soldiers of the New South Wales Corps. A number of British were wounded and killed, numerous Aboriginal people were killed with many others wounded.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 帕拉马塔战役是澳大利亚边疆战争中的一场战斗，1797年3月发生在帕拉马塔。原住民抵抗领袖彭穆尔威率领多达约100名比迪加尔战士，与新南威尔士军团的武装英国殖民者和士兵交战。多名英国人伤亡，许多原住民被杀，另有多人受伤。
zh.n: 本条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Zealand Point was fought off Zealand on 22 March 1808 during the Gunboat War. Three ships of the line and one frigate of the Royal Navy intercepted and destroyed a Danish ship of the line. The British victory in the battle resulted in the loss of the Danish navy's last ship of the line.

zh.s: 炮艇战争期间，英国皇家海军于1808年3月22日在西兰岛附近截击并摧毁了一艘丹麦战列舰。英军投入3艘战列舰和1艘护卫舰。这场胜利使丹麦海军失去了最后一艘战列舰。

en.s: Crossing the Gulf of Bothnia, specifically Kvarken (Russian: Переход через Кваркен) involved a Russian march through Kvarken, Gulf of Bothnia, to the territory of Sweden at Umeå. This occurred during the Finnish War in March 1809.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 跨越博滕海湾，具体指穿越克瓦尔肯海峡，是1809年3月芬兰战争期间俄军穿越克瓦尔肯海域，进入瑞典乌默奥地区的一次行军行动。
zh.n: 本条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Pine Island Ridge was a battle during the Second Seminole War fought on March 22, 1838 at the site of what is now Pine Island Ridge, Florida. According to US Army accounts, Major William Lauderdale surprised the Indians and drove them off Pine Island, which was an island in the Everglades at the time.

zh.s: 松岛岭战役于1838年3月22日在今佛罗里达州松岛岭所在地发生，是第二次塞米诺尔战争的一场战斗。按美国陆军记载，威廉·劳德代尔少校突袭原住民，将他们赶出松岛。松岛当时是大沼泽地中的一座岛屿。

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1840年3月22日举行议会选举。

en.s: The Five Days of Milan (Italian: Cinque giornate di Milano [ˈtʃiŋkwe dʒorˈnaːte di miˈlaːno]) was an insurrection and a major event in the Revolutionary Year of 1848 that started the First Italian War of Independence. On 18 March, a rebellion arose in the city of Milan which in five days of street fighting drove Marshal Radetzky and his Austrian soldiers from the city.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 米兰五日是1848年革命期间的一次起义，也是第一次意大利独立战争的重要开端。3月18日，米兰爆发起义，经过五天街头战斗，将拉德茨基元帅及其奥地利士兵赶出了这座城市。
zh.n: 本条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Novara or Battle of Bicocca (Bicocca is a borough of Novara) was one of the battles fought between the Austrian Empire and the Kingdom of Sardinia during the First Italian War of Independence, within the era of Italian unification. Lasting the whole day of 22 March 1849 and ending at dawn on 23 March, it resulted in a severe defeat and retreat of the Piedmontese (Sardinian) army. An uneasy armistice made in 1848 between Austria and Sardinia lasted less than seven months, before Charles Albert, King of Sardinia, denounced the truce on 12 March 1849.

zh.s: 诺瓦拉战役又称比科卡战役，比科卡是诺瓦拉的一个城区。它是意大利统一时期第一次独立战争中，奥地利帝国与撒丁王国之间的一场战斗。战斗持续整个1849年3月22日，至23日黎明结束，皮埃蒙特、即撒丁军队惨败撤退。奥地利与撒丁在1848年达成的脆弱停战持续不足七个月，撒丁国王卡洛·阿尔贝托便于1849年3月12日宣布终止休战。

en.s: The Capture of Vinh Long (Vietnamese: Vĩnh Long) on 22 March 1862 was the last major allied victory of the Cochinchina campaign (1858–62). This campaign, fought between the French and the Spanish on the one side and the Vietnamese on the other, began as a limited punitive expedition and ended as a French war of conquest. The war concluded with the establishment of the French colony of Cochinchina, a development that inaugurated nearly a century of French colonial dominance in Vietnam.

zh.s: 1862年3月22日，法西联军攻占永隆，这是1858至1862年交趾支那战役中联军最后一次主要胜利。法国与西班牙共同对越南作战，最初只是有限的惩罚性远征，最终演变为法国的征服战争。战争以法国建立交趾支那殖民地结束，开启了其在越南近一个世纪的殖民统治。

en.s: The Battle of Los Ángeles was a military action fought on 22 March 1880 between the Chilean and Peruvian armies during the Tacna and Arica Campaign of the War of the Pacific. The Chilean forces under Commander in chief Manuel Baquedano assaulted and defeated the Allied stronghold guided by Andrés Gamarra garrisoned at Los Angeles hill top.

zh.s: 1880年3月22日，太平洋战争塔克纳与阿里卡战役期间，智利与秘鲁军队在洛斯安赫莱斯交战。总司令曼努埃尔·巴克达诺率领智利军队，进攻并击败安德烈斯·加马拉指挥、驻守于洛斯安赫莱斯山顶的盟军据点。

en.s: The Battle of Tofrek was fought on 22 March 1885 some 5 miles inland from the port of Suakin on the Red Sea coast of Sudan. A contingent of some 3000 troops from the British and Indian "Suakin Field Force" led by Major General Sir John Carstairs McNeill VC, GCVO, KCB, KCMG (under the overall command of General Gerald Graham) was attacked by a Mahdist force under the leadership of Osman Digna. The Mahdists were heavily defeated, losing some 1000 of their 2000 fighters as compared to the loss of 70 British and Indian soldiers plus over 100 casualties.

zh.s: 1885年3月22日，苏丹红海港口萨瓦金向内陆约5英里处发生托弗雷克战役。杰拉尔德·格雷厄姆将军统辖下，约翰·卡斯泰尔斯·麦克尼尔少将率领英印‘萨瓦金野战军’约3,000人，遭奥斯曼·迪格纳领导的马赫迪军队袭击。麦克尼尔拥有维多利亚十字勋章、皇家维多利亚大十字勋章、巴斯爵级司令勋章及圣迈克尔和圣乔治爵级司令勋章。马赫迪军队惨败，约2,000名战士中损失1,000人；英印军队则死亡70人，另有100多人受伤。

en.t: Montreal defeats Ottawa in the 1894 Stanley Cup final
en.s: On March 22, 1894, Montreal AAA defeated Ottawa 3–1 in Montreal to retain the Stanley Cup.
en.n: The first playoff game of that championship had been played on March 17.

zh.t: 蒙特利尔队在1894年斯坦利杯决赛中获胜
zh.s: 1894年3月22日，蒙特利尔AAA队在加拿大蒙特利尔以3比1击败渥太华队，卫冕斯坦利杯。
zh.n: 该届赛事的首场附加赛于3月17日举行。

en.t: The Lumière brothers demonstrate the Cinématographe in Paris
en.s: On March 22, 1895, the Lumière brothers demonstrated their Cinématographe to members of the Société d’encouragement pour l’industrie nationale in Paris, screening Workers Leaving the Lumière Factory.
en.n: Their commercial screenings for paying audiences began later in 1895.

zh.t: 卢米埃尔兄弟在巴黎演示电影放映机
zh.s: 1895年3月22日，卢米埃尔兄弟在巴黎向法国国家工业促进会的会员演示电影放映机，放映了《工厂大门》。
zh.n: 面向付费观众的商业放映于1895年晚些时候开始。

en.t: Charilaos Vasilakos wins a marathon trial in Greece
en.s: On March 22, 1896, Charilaos Vasilakos won a Greek marathon trial held to select athletes for the Athens Olympics, finishing in 3 hours and 18 minutes.
en.n: This was an Olympic qualifying race, not the Olympic marathon. Greece’s Julian-calendar date was March 10.

zh.t: 瓦西拉科斯赢得希腊马拉松选拔赛
zh.s: 1896年3月22日，哈里劳斯·瓦西拉科斯以3小时18分赢得希腊的一场马拉松选拔赛，争取参加雅典奥运会的资格。
zh.n: 这是奥运会前的选拔赛，并非奥运会马拉松正赛。当时希腊使用的儒略历日期为3月10日。

en.s: The Tejeros Convention (Spanish: Convención de Tejeros; Tagalog: Kapulungan sa Tejeros), also referred to as the Tejeros Assembly or Tejeros Congress, was a meeting held on March 22, 1897, in San Francisco de Malabon (now General Trias), Cavite, Philippines. This gathering brought together factions of the Katipunan, namely Magdiwang and Magdalo, and led to the establishment of a new revolutionary government that took over leadership of the Philippine Revolution, replacing the Katipunan.

It was officially known as the "Augusta National Invitation Tournament" for its first five editions, but informally as the Masters from the start. CBS Radio broadcast updates daily, making this the second golf tournament to be broadcast live. The sportscaster was Herbert H.

zh.s: 首届美国大师赛于1934年3月22日至25日在美国佐治亚州奥古斯塔的奥古斯塔国家高尔夫俱乐部举行。赛事前五届的正式名称是“奥古斯塔国家邀请赛”，但从一开始人们就非正式地称之为“大师赛”。哥伦比亚广播公司每天播报赛事进展，使它成为第二个进行现场直播的高尔夫赛事。体育播报员是赫伯特·H.。

en.s: Operation Berlin (German: Unternehmen Berlin) was a raid conducted by the two German Scharnhorst-class battleships against Allied shipping in the North Atlantic between 22 January and 22 March 1941. It formed part of the Battle of the Atlantic during the Second World War. The Scharnhorst and Gneisenau sailed from Germany, operated across the North Atlantic, sank or captured 22 Allied merchant vessels, and finished their mission by docking in occupied France.

zh.s: 柏林行动是两艘德国沙恩霍斯特级战列舰于1941年1月22日至3月22日在北大西洋对盟军航运发动的袭击，是第二次世界大战大西洋海战的一部分。“沙恩霍斯特”号和“格奈森瑙”号从德国出发，在北大西洋活动，击沉或俘获22艘盟军商船，任务结束后停靠在被占领的法国。

en.s: The Second Battle of Sirte (on 22 March 1942) was a naval engagement in the Mediterranean Sea, north of the Gulf of Sidra and south-east of Malta, during the Second World War. The escorting warships of a British convoy to Malta held off a much more powerful squadron of the Regia Marina (Italian Navy). The British convoy was composed of four merchant ships, escorted by four light cruisers, one anti-aircraft cruiser and 17 destroyers.

zh.s: 第二次锡尔特湾海战于1942年3月22日在地中海爆发，地点位于锡尔特湾以北、马耳他东南方，是第二次世界大战期间的一场海战。英国船队驶往马耳他，护航舰艇顶住了实力强得多的意大利皇家海军舰队的进攻。英国船队有4艘商船，由4艘轻巡洋舰、1艘防空巡洋舰和17艘驱逐舰护航。

en.s: The 1941 Copa Ibarguren was the 18th edition of the national cup of Argentina. The final was played by the champions of both leagues, River Plate (Primera División), and Newell's Old Boys (Liga Rosarina de Football), both crowned during the 1941 seasons. The reserve squad of Newell's Old Boys was fielded for the match. Managed by Renato Cesarini, River Plate beat Newell's 3–0 at Ferro Carril Oeste Stadium, winning their 2nd Copa Ibarguren title.

zh.s: 1941年伊巴古伦杯是阿根廷全国杯赛的第18届。决赛由两大联赛冠军河床队和纽维尔老男孩队交锋，两队分别是1941赛季的联赛冠军。纽维尔老男孩派出预备队参赛。雷纳托·塞萨里尼执教的河床队在西部铁路俱乐部球场以3比0获胜，第二次捧起伊巴古伦杯。

en.s: Khatyn or Chatyń (Belarusian and Russian: Хаты́нь, pronounced [xɐˈtɨnʲ]) was a village of 26 houses and 156 inhabitants in Belarus, in Lahoysk Raion, Minsk Region, 50 km away from Minsk. On 22 March 1943, the entire population of the village was massacred by the Schutzmannschaft Battalion 118 of Ukrainische Hilfspolizei. The battalion was formed in July 1942 in Kiev and was made up mostly of Ukrainian nationalist collaborators from Western Ukraine and Hiwis, assisted by the Dirlewanger Waffen-SS special battalion. The massacre was not an unusual incident in modern-day Belarus during World War II.

zh.s: 哈廷是白俄罗斯明斯克州洛戈伊斯克区的一座村庄，距明斯克50公里，有26栋房屋、156名居民。1943年3月22日，乌克兰辅助警察第118保安营在党卫军迪勒万格特别营协助下，屠杀了全村居民。第118营于1942年7月在基辅成立，主要由来自西乌克兰的民族主义合作者及为德军效力的辅助人员组成。第二次世界大战期间，这类屠杀在今天的白俄罗斯境内并非罕见。

en.t: The Arab League is founded when a charter is adopted in Cairo, Egypt
en.s: The Arab League, officially the League of Arab States, is a regional organisation in the Arab world. The Arab League was formed in Cairo on 22 March 1945, initially with seven members: Egypt, Iraq, Transjordan, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Syria, and North Yemen. Currently, the League has 22 members, including three non-Arab countries, namely Comoros, Djibouti and Somalia.

zh.s: 阿拉伯国家联盟于1945年3月22日在埃及开罗成立，最初有7个成员国：埃及、伊拉克、外约旦、黎巴嫩、沙特阿拉伯、叙利亚和北也门。该地区组织的正式名称是阿拉伯国家联盟。目前共有22个成员国，其中3个国家并非阿拉伯国家，分别是科摩罗、吉布提和索马里。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in the Republic of China on March 22, 1954 to elect the President and Vice President. The vote took place at the Chung-Shan Hall in Taipei. Incumbent President Chiang Kai-shek was re-elected for the second term. The premier Chen Cheng was elected to be the Vice-President. These were the first elections that took place since the fall of the mainland to the Chinese Communist Party in 1949.

en.s: Regional elections were held in France on 22 March 1992. At stake were the presidencies of each of France's 26 régions, which, though they don't have legislative autonomy, manage sizeable budgets. The parliamentary right, led by the conservative Rally for the Republic and the centre-right Union for French Democracy won a landslide, winning 20 of 22 metropolitan regional presidencies. en.s: USAir Flight 405 was a regularly scheduled American domestic passenger flight between LaGuardia Airport in New York City and Cleveland, Ohio. Despite a late challenge by Texas Senator Ted Cruz, Donald Trump won the primary and netted all 58 delegates in the winner-take-all contest.

zh.t: 2016年亚利桑那州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年亚利桑那州共和党总统初选于3月22日举行，是共和党在2016年总统选举前举行的各州提名竞赛之一。尽管得克萨斯州参议员特德·克鲁兹在最后阶段发起挑战，唐纳德·特朗普仍赢得初选，并在这场胜者全得的竞赛中拿下全部58名代表。

en.s: The 2016 Idaho Democratic presidential caucuses took place on March 22 in the U.S. state of Idaho as one of the Democratic Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. Voters convened in each of Idaho's 44 counties at 7 p.m. Mountain Standard Time/6 p.m Pacific Standard Time to proportionally allocate the state's 27 delegates to the Democratic National Convention in Philadelphia in July.

zh.t: 2016年爱达荷州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2016年爱达荷州民主党总统党团会议于3月22日举行，是民主党在2016年总统选举前举行的提名竞赛之一。爱达荷州44个县的选民分别于山地标准时间晚上7时、太平洋标准时间晚上6时集合，按比例分配该州27名民主党全国代表大会代表。

en.s: The 2016 Arizona Democratic presidential primary was held on March 22 in the U.S. state of Arizona as one of the Democratic Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. On the same day, the Democratic Party held caucuses in Idaho and Utah, while the Republican Party held primaries in two states, including their own Arizona primary and a primary in American Samoa.

zh.t: 2016年亚利桑那州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年亚利桑那州民主党总统初选于3月22日举行，是民主党在2016年总统选举前举行的提名竞赛之一。同一天，民主党还在爱达荷州和犹他州举行党团会议；共和党则在两个州举行初选，包括亚利桑那州初选和美属萨摩亚初选。

en.s: The Battle of Tabqa was a Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) military operation against the Islamic State (IS) to capture and secure the Tabqa Dam, Tabqa (al-Thawrah), Tabqa Airbase, and the surrounding countryside during the 2016–2017 Raqqa campaign of the larger Rojava-Islamist conflict of the Syrian civil war. The SDF assault began on 22 March 2017, and resulted in the capture of Tabqa and the Tabqa Dam on 10 May 2017.

zh.s: 塔布卡战役是叙利亚民主力量针对‘伊斯兰国’开展的军事行动，旨在夺取并控制塔布卡大坝、塔布卡市（又称革命城）、塔布卡空军基地及周边乡村。它属于2016至2017年拉卡战役，也属于叙利亚内战中罗贾瓦势力与伊斯兰主义武装之间的更大冲突。进攻始于2017年3月22日，叙利亚民主力量最终于5月10日夺取塔布卡及大坝。

en.s: On 22 March 2017, a terrorist attack took place outside the Palace of Westminster in London, seat of the British Parliament. Khalid Masood, a 52-year-old Briton, drove a car into pedestrians on the pavement along the south side of Westminster Bridge and Bridge Street, injuring more than 50 people, four of them fatally.

zh.s: 2017年3月22日，英国议会所在地、伦敦威斯敏斯特宫外发生恐怖袭击。52岁的英国人哈立德·马苏德，驾车冲撞威斯敏斯特桥南侧及桥街人行道上的行人，造成50多人受伤，其中4人伤重死亡。

en.s: In the aftermath of the Pulwama attack on 14 February 2019, a standoff emerged between India and Pakistan consisting of cross-border airstrikes and exchanges of gunfire between India and Pakistan across the de facto border in the disputed Kashmir region, which is subject to extensive territorial claims by both countries. The Pulwama attack in Jammu and Kashmir had killed 40 Indian Central Reserve Police Force personnel.

en.s: On March 22, 2020, India observed the Janata Curfew, a voluntary day of staying at home requested by prime minister Narendra Modi as part of the response to COVID-19.
en.n: Modi had announced the request on March 19.

zh.s: 2020年3月22日，印度响应总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的呼吁，实行“人民宵禁”，倡导民众自愿留在家中，以应对新冠疫情。
zh.n: 莫迪于3月19日发出这一呼吁。

en.t: Greece announces nationwide restrictions on movement
en.s: On March 22, 2020, Greek prime minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis announced a ban on non-essential travel and movement across Greece, to begin at 6 a.m. the following day.
en.n: The announcement was made on March 22; the restrictions began on March 23.

zh.n: 本条记录的是3月22日的宣布；措施于3月23日开始实施。

en.s: On March 22, 2021, a mass shooting occurred at a King Soopers supermarket in Boulder, Colorado, United States. Ten people were killed, including a local on-duty police officer. The shooter, 21-year-old Ahmad Al Aliwi Al-Issa, was arrested after being shot in the right leg. He was temporarily hospitalized before being moved to the county jail.

zh.s: 2021年3月22日，美国科罗拉多州博尔德一家King Soopers超市发生大规模枪击，造成10人死亡，包括一名正在执勤的当地警察。21岁的枪手艾哈迈德·阿里维·伊萨右腿中弹后被捕，短暂住院后被转至县监狱。

en.s: Bellator Champions Series 1: Anderson vs. Moore (also known as Bellator Champions Series Belfast and Bellator 302) was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA, that took place on March 22, 2024, at the SSE Arena in Belfast, Northern Ireland. It marked the first show to air on Max as part of a new U.S. television deal with Warner Bros. Discovery.

zh.t: Bellator冠军系列赛1：安德森对摩尔
zh.s: ‘Bellator冠军系列赛1：安德森对摩尔’又称‘Bellator贝尔法斯特冠军系列赛’或‘Bellator 302’，是Bellator综合格斗联盟举办的赛事，于2024年3月22日在北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特的SSE竞技场举行。根据与华纳兄弟探索签订的新美国电视转播协议，这是首场在Max平台播出的赛事。

en.t: At least 151 people are killed and 609 injured in a bombing and mass shooting at the Crocus City Hall in Krasnogorsk, Russia
en.s: On 22 March 2024, a coordinated terrorist attack against civilians occurred at the Crocus City Hall music venue in Crocus City, Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast, Russia. The attack began at around 20:00 MSK (UTC+3), shortly before the Russian band Picnic was scheduled to play a sold-out show at the venue.

zh.t: 番红花城市音乐厅恐怖袭击
zh.s: 2024年3月22日，俄罗斯莫斯科州克拉斯诺戈尔斯克番红花城的番红花城市音乐厅发生针对平民的协同恐怖袭击。袭击约于莫斯科时间20时（协调世界时17时）开始，当时俄罗斯乐队“野餐”即将在场馆举办一场门票售罄的演出。袭击造成至少151人死亡、609人受伤。

en.s: NWA Hard Times V was a professional wrestling event produced by the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA). It was the fifth event in the Hard Times chronology. en.s: Cinéma du réel (Lit. "Cinema of the Real") is an international documentary annual film festival held in Paris, France, since 1978. It is organised by the Bibliothèque publique d'information (BPI), and screenings take place at the Pompidou Centre in Paris as well as partner cinemas in the city. The 47th edition of the festival takes place in March 2025.

en.s: The 2026 Rhineland-Palatinate state election was held on 22 March 2026 to elect the 19th Landtag of Rhineland-Palatinate. The Christian Democratic Union of Germany (CDU) won with 31.0% of votes, while the Social Democratic Party of Germany, which led the state government since 1991, suffered significant losses and fell to second place with 25.9% of votes.

zh.s: 莱茵兰-普法尔茨州于2026年3月22日举行州选举，选出第19届州议会。德国基督教民主联盟以31.0%的选票获胜。自1991年以来一直领导州政府的德国社会民主党遭遇重大失利，以25.9%的选票跌至第二位。

en.t: Air Canada Express Flight 8646 collides with a fire truck at LaGuardia
en.s: On March 22, 2026, Air Canada Express Flight 8646 collided with an airport fire truck while landing at LaGuardia Airport in New York. Both pilots were killed.
en.n: The collision occurred late on March 22 in New York; it was already March 23 in UTC.

zh.t: 加航快运8646航班在拉瓜迪亚机场与消防车相撞
zh.s: 2026年3月22日晚，加航快运8646航班在美国纽约拉瓜迪亚机场降落时，与机场消防车相撞，两名飞行员遇难。
zh.n: 记录采用纽约当地日期；事发时，协调世界时已是3月23日。
